snippet.title: Drill Core Going 1.0 on July 17th | Release Date Trailer | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821800/Drill_Core/ 

Dig Deeper. Drill Smarter. Profit Faster. Coming to full release with a new update on July 17th

Welcome to Drill Core Inc. a base-building roguelike strategy where deeper drilling drives progress.

By day you command miners, carriers, and guards, tunnelling through alien crust. Build adaptive bases, upgrade your gear, then brace for nightfall when the planet pushes back. If it’s self-defence, it’s simply responsible terraforming: reach the core, tune the climate to client specs, and lift off before you’re overrun.

💬 Join the community on Discord → https://discord.com/invite/DJ2d9D5dNM
🐦 X/Twitter → https://x.com/DrillCoreGame

Like the trailer? Smash that 👍, subscribe for dev updates, and tell us which Oversight Department you’ll pledge to first!
